audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart said 'Skill' for rows 0-4 and 'Vladimir' for rows 5-6, while the content layer and packet levelChart both give Orianna rows 0-3, Skill on 4-5 and Orianna on 2+ items.
audit.why: Packet and content agree, and the kit backs it: pre-6 Vladimir has only Transfusion (600 range, 9s at rank 1) and Tides of Blood (600 range) and pays his own health to cast, against an 815-range Q. Late, Sanguine Pool saves only himself while Shockwave sets up five.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved to Orianna on rows 0-3, Skill on row 5 and Orianna on row 6, with whys and ratings rewritten to match. Content win[] already held the correct tokens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text and phase whys were generic Orianna boilerplate that never named his actual spikes.
audit.why: His real spikes are level 6 (Hemoplague plus a 28s Sanguine Pool) and first item, where Transfusion healing outpaces poke; Crimson Pact turns every point of AP into health and back.
audit.corrected: Spikes and whys now key to Transfusion's 9s window, the 28s pool, the level-6 all-in and the Grievous Wounds timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No ability interaction stated anywhere; anti-heal absent from the lane text despite two healing abilities.
audit.why: Transfusion heals him and Hemoplague heals him per champion hit, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade. Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability on a 28s cooldown at rank 1 — it dodges a committed Shockwave, so the R goes down after the pool, not before. Tides of Blood is blocked by minions between you.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Sanguine Pool 28s->16s, Transfusion 9s and your R 110s; spikes[2] now names Grievous Wounds; do's/don'ts key to his 600-range ceiling.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16, Transfusion 9s at rank 1, Command: Shockwave 110s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and content 'mid' contained a broken sentence: 'force his mana... his health-cost sustain'.
audit.why: Lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED, plus a visibly corrupted string shipped to readers.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to answer their own titles; the mid sentence repaired.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid claimed protect-ball 'doubles every gank' (lint UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE).
audit.corrected: Replaced with what the ball actually delivers.

edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — Vladimir is a poor level-1 laner and his only answer is a 9s Transfusion.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online and he pays health to farm — chunk him on his last-hits, since Tides of Blood only reaches 600 range.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: E completes the kit: ball-on-self answers his step-up, and you trade inside Transfusion's 9s window while he cannot heal.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: Shove and deny: every wave he farms costs him health, and your Q at 815 out-ranges his entire 600-range kit.

edits.before: Vladimir
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: Even window: his first-item sustain matches your Luden's poke, so buy Grievous Wounds before you commit to long trades.

edits.before: Vladimir
edits.after: Orianna

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: Grouped you win: Shockwave sets up your whole team, while Sanguine Pool rescues only him and leaves his carries alone.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Command: Protect has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool (W): 28s at rank 1 and still 16s at rank 5 — 2 seconds untargetable, so bait it out before you spend your R. - Transfusion (Q): 9s at rank 1 — trade inside that window, he cannot heal it back. - Your R at 110s buys a fight, not poke.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball carries a shield, the speed field and your R into the gank.

edits.before: Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: His Q and E both stop at 600 — a ball parked on his last-hit spot taxes health he then has to Transfusion back.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Your Q is 7s at rank 1 dropping to 3s at rank 5 and his Transfusion is 9s — chunk him on the minion he steps up for, then recall the ball.

edits.before: Vladimir spends Sanguine Pool early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Your passive damage grows on repeat hits — weave an auto between Q and W, never cast and walk.

edits.before: That is Vladimir’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Ball-less he walks to 600 at no mana cost and out-sustains you.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Your R is 110s at rank 1 — spend it on a wave and the next fight has nothing left to answer his Hemoplague engage.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by surviving to 6, healing every chip back with Transfusion, and turning that gold into health and AP at once.

edits.before: If Vladimir gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Sanguine Pool extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: A kill lets Crimson Pact turn his gold into health and AP at once, so stop trading into a full resource bar and farm with Q-W from range. Two kills: buy Grievous Wounds early and hold R for a fight.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — protect-ball on your engage shields him and delivers your R, so one Shockwave answers his Hemoplague with a bigger one.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you keep bullying - shove him in, deny CS, and force his mana... his health-cost sustain, so he is always trading HP to farm under your poke. Level 6 flips to even: Hemoplague and Sanguine Pool give him an all-in plus an escape, so keep the pressure but don't dive a fresh pool.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you keep bullying - shove him in, deny CS, and make him pay health for every wave, because his sustain costs HP under your poke. Level 6 flips to even: Hemoplague and Sanguine Pool give him an all-in plus an escape, so keep the pressure but never dive a fresh 28s pool.

edits.before: This is where his sustain snowballs into a real threat, so the window is even - his Q healing off a completed item can outpace your poke. Keep the wave on his tower so his lifesteal off minions is minimized and force him to heal instead of scale.
edits.after: This is where his sustain snowballs, so the window is even - Transfusion off a completed item outpaces your poke unless you are carrying Grievous Wounds. Buy anti-heal on this back, keep the wave on his tower, and make him pay health for every minion.

notes: Full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer on rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6; the packet levelChart matches the content layer, so the full layer was moved to match and win[] needed no edit. Content 'mid' shipped a corrupted sentence ('force his mana... his health-cost sustain') and is repaired here. The needs-antiheal interaction is now stated in spikes[2] and breakdown.feeding. Open tension left alone: diff is TRICKY at 7/10 with a 48.87% win rate, yet the chart gives Orianna five of seven rows — the rating and the chart pull in different directions and I could not settle it from the kit, so diff/diffRating were untouched.
